title: THE DANCE ROOM
comment: Third room, next-level plan 3.3: mansion dance room, violet panelling, bandstand moved aside so the corridor arch is the real exit.
scene: It is the mansion's dance room at night, seen at an angle: a grown-up, intimate hall of soft greyed violet, warm cream plaster and low amber lamps.
keep: every wall edge, window, pilaster, the far bandstand and doorway, every floor joint and the horizon

floor.layout: a dark polished stone dance floor, one even tone across its whole area out to every edge of the picture, with the same grid as image 1.
floor.paint: The floor is plain dark polished stone, a deep dark grey-violet, close in tone to the shadows on the walls, in large square slabs with thin straight joints: the joints stay exactly where they are, with fine mottled texture and one even, soft low sheen from end to end, with a short soft warm glow just in front of the doorway, and it lies open, calm and clear down to the bottom edge of the picture.

panel.layout: muted greyed violet carved wood panelling with raised panels, gilded scrollwork borders and a deep moulded cornice.
panel.paint: The walls are deep muted violet-plum wood panels with a soft lacquer, in the rich ornate style of an old Latin dance palace: carved raised panels with gilded scrollwork borders, an upper wall of damask pattern in dim plum and old gold, a dark carved wainscot, a deep moulded cornice, tall gilt-framed mirrors holding small points of amber light, small warm brass wall sconces and thin cream mouldings, all in soft dim light.

door.layout: a tall doorway at the far end.
door.paint: A cream stone archway at the far end, the same width and height as the doorway in image 1 with its foot on the same line, opens onto a dim warm corridor, seen only as soft amber depth.

window.layout: tall arched windows on the left wall.
window.paint: Tall arched windows on the left wall only, with fine leaded glass, are a dark grey-blue with a thin pale cyan line along the leading.

pilaster.layout: carved pilasters on the right wall.
pilaster.paint: Carved cream pilasters with fluted shafts and gilded leaf capitals run along the right wall between deep muted violet panels, lit warm from below.

stage.layout: a low bandstand at the far left.
stage.paint: A low dark wooden platform with a short muted violet velvet skirt in fine pleats, knee high and exactly the size of the block in image 1, stands empty at the far left.

lamp.layout: glowing chandeliers hanging from the ceiling.
lamp.paint: Small amber lantern chandeliers with fine metalwork hang high in the air.
